  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      private Result(StreamInterface outlet, double inletEnthalpyW, double outletEnthalpyW, double requestedDutyW, double absorbedDutyW, double dutyResidualW, double relativeDutyResidual)
      Store accepted oil-side results.
      Parameters:
      outlet - accepted outlet stream
      inletEnthalpyW - inlet EOS enthalpy flow [W]
      outletEnthalpyW - outlet EOS enthalpy flow [W]
      requestedDutyW - external useful-heat specification [W]
      absorbedDutyW - independently read outlet-minus-inlet EOS enthalpy [W]
      dutyResidualW - absorbed minus requested duty [W]
      relativeDutyResidual - absolute residual divided by requested duty, with a 1 W floor
